Update Content:
Android Version
Upgraded from Android 15 to Android 16 for enhanced security, more features, and a better user experience.

OS Version
Upgraded from XOS 15.1.2 to XOS 16.2.0 for a smarter user interface that gives your device a new look.

Security
Updated Google Security Patch to April 1, 2026.

AI
Upgraded AI Suggestions with more system service cards, enhanced noise cancellation for more calling scenarios, added AI Class Timetable, and optimized AI Notes, AI Writing, Dynamic Bar, and AI Search.

New Design
1. Added the Depth-Effect Homescreen feature that lets you enable a depth effect with uploaded portrait wallpapers or built-in wallpapers, giving the home screen a more layered look.
2. Supported setting live photos as live wallpapers to bring vivid moments back to life.
3. Supported generating a theme that matches the style or colors of an uploaded static wallpaper.

Multi-Device Connection
Fully upgraded Joy Connect, enabling services to flow seamlessly across multiple devices.

Security & Privacy
1. Supported finding phones remotely even when they are offline.
2. Optimized Unlock Security Protection, Privacy Password, and Dual System.

Communication
Enhanced communication in weak signal environments and optimized power consumption for hotspot sharing.

Performance
Added faster system animations to significantly improve app launch speed, and optimized responsive scheduling and MemFusion efficiency.

More
1. Fully upgraded cloud services with support for more data types and features.
2. Added Esports Mode in XArena for greater spatial immersion in games.
3. Added AI Voice Prompt, Smart Trigger, and Voice Broadcast in Game Assistant Panel.
4. Optimized All-Scenario Bypass Charging, supporting gaming, live streaming, navigation, and more scenarios.

Camera
Upgraded the camera interface for a refreshed user experience.

Folax
1. Fully upgraded Folax to deliver a smarter and richer AI experience.
2. Redesigned the client interface, delivering a cleaner layout, smoother operation, and an upgraded overall user experience.
3. Added support for more languages for smoother communication.
4. Features may vary by OS version and device model.

Reminding:
1. Optimized system stability and performance while fixing other issues.
2. Visit the XClub forum (https://www.infinix.club) for more information.

firmware.description:
It is recommended to perform OTA upgrade when the battery is over 50%.

Update Version:
X6873-16.3.0.150SP09(OP006PF001AZ)

Update Content:
OS Version
Upgraded from XOS 16.2 to XOS 16.3 for a smarter user interface and a refreshed look for your device.

Security
Updated Google Security Patch to August 1, 2026.

AI
1. Optimized AI subtitle generation for faster speeds and more accurate syncing with live video streams, improving the cross-language viewing experience.
2. Upgraded travel management across scenarios with support for international and cross-city travel cards that intelligently show itinerary information based on your location.

Privacy & Security
1. Optimized privacy permission management by expanding permission access alerts to home screen widgets and Zero Screen cards, giving you more transparent control over sensitive permissions.
2. Optimized cross-system data sharing. Sync capabilities now cover contacts and system settings, making switching between systems more seamless and consistent.

Communication
1. Updated call recording with automatic recording for selected contacts and optimized file naming for saved recordings.

Smoothness
1. Streamlined system services by rebuilding core services to reduce power consumption, improve performance, extend battery life, and deliver smoother operation.
2. Enhanced cleanup capabilities with deeper system junk scanning to free up storage more accurately.

Controller Features
1. Added a new controller mode supporting connection, configuration, and firmware updates for the GT NX Controller, as well as controller game recommendations.
2. Added a new controller module supporting mode switching and mapping settings for the GT NX Controller, including custom button mapping and advanced control settings.

Fixed Issues:
1. Fixed issues where image covers could load incompletely, transparent animated images could display abnormal backgrounds, and some new photos could be sorted by time inaccurately.
2. Fixed issues where, after device activation, cloud folder apps could reappear at the end of the home screen, and where lock screen clock styles could appear inconsistent before and after a global theme upgrade.
3. Fixed display issues with resizable icons and improved Launcher stability after home screen restoration on the following day, making long-term use more reliable.
4. Fixed touch responsiveness issues in parts of the notification bar to improve interaction responsiveness.
5. Fixed the issue where connection status could display incorrectly after closing VPN apps.
6. Optimized multitasking, first-time swiping on Zero Screen, and browsing in popular social media apps for smoother animations.
7. Fixed stuttering in the screen unlock animation and lag when loading pop-ups after tapping a Wi-Fi network that was not connected, improving interaction responsiveness.

Reminding:
1. Optimized system stability and performance while fixing other issues.
2. Visit the XClub forum (https://www.infinix.club) for more information.
